keywords: Problem solving process 2.Think/Decide logically 3.Project-Based Learning 4.On-the-Job Training (OJT) 5.Real data
educationalGoal: In this course, students gather the knowledge, experience, and information needed to solve others’ problems in real-world settings, integrate them individually or in teams, and carry out organized project activities as a team. Students build on the basic skills learned in the prerequisite course Project Design I. Through thes e activities, they explore problems with diverse possible answers and develop the ability to solve them logically and creatively.
advice: Teams conduct organized project activities using a main theme provided by the instructor, targeting the resoluti on of problems faced by communities, companies, and other real-world stakeholders. Students collect not only pre viously acquired knowledge and experience but also practical data and information necessary to advance the proje ct, acquire new insights through research and hands-on experience, and integrate these into activities grounded in logical thinking. Students aim to carry out deeper project work efficiently by building on the fundamental skills acquired in the prerequisite course Project Design I. When conducting activities, pay attention to the following points: - Monitor real-world conditions and problems, and identify project themes within a scope appropriate to each ind ividual’s or team’s capabilities. - Obtain data from reliable information sources. - Collect a sufficient amount of information worthy of analysis and use appropriate tools for that analysis. - Consider how to carry out work within the team (organization) and how to behave as a team member. - Be considerate when dealing with stakeholders who hold different perspectives. - Through thorough inquiry, assess your own level and recognize the importance of foundational knowledge.
